settings.title: Model settings
settings.activeNote: No OpenAI-compatible model connection is saved yet.
settings.activeConfigured: The model configuration is saved on this server. The API key is never returned to the browser.
settings.urlHint: Enter the API root, without /chat/completions. Example: https://api.deepseek.com/v1
settings.keyHint: The key is encrypted with AES-GCM before it is stored. It is never returned to the browser.
settings.keepKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key. The browser only receives a masked identifier.
settings.configured: Configuration loaded. Run a connection test when ready.
settings.notReady: No model connection is saved yet.
settings.testFailed: Connection failed. Check the base URL, model, key, and provider status.
settings.rateLimit: Please wait a few seconds before another test.
settings.required: Base URL and model are required.
settings.saved: Configuration saved. The API key was not returned to the browser.
settings.encryptionMissing: APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing or invalid on the server.
settings.testCost: Connection tests send a real model request and may incur provider charges.
settings.researchNote: These values apply to new research tasks. The current values are the original defaults.
settings.researchSaved: Research settings saved. They apply to the next research task.
settings.maxQueriesHint: 1–10 queries. More queries improve coverage but take longer.
settings.maxSourcesHint: 1–20 unique web sources included in the evidence set.
settings.maxSourceCharsHint: 1,000–50,000 extracted characters sent from each source to the model.
settings.maxHtmlBytesHint: 100,000–10,000,000 bytes downloaded before a page is rejected.
settings.maxClaimsHint: 1–30 claims extracted and reviewed for each research task.
settings.maxOutputTokensHint: 1,000–64,000 tokens. Reasoning models need a higher budget.

history.confirm: Permanently delete this report? This cannot be undone.
history.saveFailed: Report generated, but saving failed. Download a Markdown backup.
